name: conversation-skeleton
title: Conversation Skeleton
description: A conversation not here yet (ConversationSkeleton): a message asked, at the end edge in a bubble the user's message's size and corners, and the lines of an answer in the conversation's type (16px on lines of 28px); a status named by label ("Loading conversation"), seen only past a short wait (animate-wait-in) so a quick load never flashes it. SkeletonLines: lines of text not here yet, each a thin rounded bar on a line of the text's height, so the place is as tall as the text will be; widths one a line.
